name: Parseh::Test
_comment: A fixture deck: one vocab and one opposites card of this language, filed under its language folder exactly as the store now writes them. Every fixture deck shares the NAME 'Parseh::Test' on purpose -- two languages may hold a deck of the same name (and so the same slug), since they live in different folders; the directory names them apart only for a human reading the fixture. Never a deck the dashboards write into. English is the one language whose registry anki.field is not its own name: the note types already have a field called 'English' (the meaning, on every language's card), so a second one would be a duplicate field name, which Anki does not allow and which anki_export.note_fields would resolve by putting the meaning in both -- the word itself would never reach the card. The field is 'Headword' instead, and the cards below are what proves it round-trips.
